description: This file defines a Swift class 'TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer' that wraps the AVFoundation speech synthesis framework for text-to-speech functionality. It manages speech synthesis tasks, including starting, stopping, timeout watchdogs, and handling delegate callbacks for speech events.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for speech synthesis tasks, managing speech utterances, timing out, and handling start/cancel events.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Asynchronously performs speech synthesis for the given text with optional language and a start callback, with timeout handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech synthesis and cancels related tasks.
